role: Write ONE slide section as JS calls (no prose). Self-contained — no other file needed.
response_format: Output as an actual file. If files aren't possible, wrap ALL output in five backticks (````` ... `````) as one block.
exact_syntax: addContent(`...HTML...`,opts?); addQuiz([{q,options:[4],correct:idx,explain}],opts?); addFillBlank([{code,blanks:[{id,answer}],explain}],opts?); addMatching([{term,def}]|[[...],[...]],opts?) — backticks exactly as shown for addContent, real JS literals for the rest.

calls.addContent(html,opts?): 1 slide; tags: h1 h2 p.lede div.callout div.grid3>div.card pre>code table.glossary-table div.glossary-strip div.glossary-columns — never plain text
calls.addFillBlank([{code,blanks:[{id,answer}]: blanks marked __id__ in code; Check+hint+wrong-strike UI auto-generated
calls.addMatching([{term,def}]|[[...],[...]],o: matching pairs; array-of-arrays = 2-3 sets on one slide

opts: label, note(Greek), bg(image path), overlayAlpha(0..1,def .5), backgroundSize(cover|contain|auto|"100% 100%"|"100% auto"), backgroundRepeat(no-repeat|repeat|repeat-x|repeat-y), backgroundPosition(CSS value, def "top left") — bg works on all 4 functions
spoiler:
Drag to reveal →
...
— unlocks by drag only, not click
code_blocks: Color code by hand: <span class="tok-kw|tok-type|tok-str|tok-com|tok-num|tok-func">. Escape < > & in code text.
rules: Greek prose/English code comments; quiz options same length, correct slot varies, distractors plausible (1 slightly longer trap ok), code self-contained+commented, never solve the exercise, no title/init slides, don't hand-write score text (automatic)
